sourceEvent.summary: External developer asks whether a cross-framework runtime for idempotency, execution state, approval/policy, recovery, and audit would be adopted and what would block adoption.

decisiveEvidence: Existing hostile proof showed external GitHub write succeeded while caller timed out; recovery reread external state and settled without duplicate execution.
Current autonomous kernel encodes executed_unverified, fresh verification, settlement receipts, and approval gates.
External SABLE challenge already requested one real native execution against this reliability boundary.

prep.objective: Answer the adoption question with evidence, identify real blockers, and propose one bounded interoperability test rather than another architecture pitch.
prep.firstAction: Draft a concise reply distinguishing what is already proven from what remains unproven, then ask for one concrete adoption condition/test.
prep.doneWhen: Reply is ready for approval and can be posted without additional research.
prep.receiptRequired: Approved GitHub comment text; after posting, fresh issue reread showing the exact comment.

proves: We have a framework-agnostic hostile reconciliation proof and a tested internal autonomous execution kernel.
doesNotProve: external teams will adopt a separate runtime layer
the component is production-ready for general use
